descriptionFull: The grey partridge ( Perdix perdix ), also known as the English partridge , Hungarian partridge , or hun , is a gamebird in the pheasant family Phasianidae of the order Galliformes, gallinaceous birds. The scientific name is the Latin for "partridge", and is itself derived from Ancient Greek perdix .
